parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that determines the start point of the query.

> The request parameters must be the same as those of the last request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud service. For more information about the Alibaba Cloud services supported by ActionTrail, see [Supported Alibaba Cloud services](~~28829~~).
